info.name: MediGraph
info.description: One patient (Ramesh Sharma) through the MediGraph API via the gateway. Run the folders in order: later requests use tokens and IDs saved by earlier ones. Local dev only: tokens come from the gateway's /dev/token endpoint, which exists only in the local profile.

item.name: Auth / dev tokens
item.description: Tokens from the gateway's local dev issuer (dev profile only). The issuer key is regenerated when the gateway restarts, so re-run this folder after a restart.

exec: pm.test("NEW (or AUTO_LINK if he is already registered)", () => pm.expect(b.decision).to.be.oneOf(["NEW", "AUTO_LINK"]));

exec: pm.test("AUTO_LINK to the same Health ID", () => { pm.expect(b.decision).to.eql("AUTO_LINK"); pm.expect(b.healthId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("healthId")); });
